# Strathmark

> Strathmark is Graeme's Edinburgh-based practice building websites and running SEO and Google Ads for established UK businesses, usually turning over £500k or more. Work is judged on revenue, cost per sale and return, not traffic or clicks. Specialist work for car leasing brokers and automotive businesses.

## Services
- [Website design](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/website-design): fast, properly built websites written to win enquiries, with SEO and revenue tracking built in. From £3,500, fixed price.
- [SEO for Google and AI search](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/seo-services): technical fixes, content, local search and AI search visibility. From £850 a month.
- [Google Ads management](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/google-ads-management): campaigns built around what a sale is worth, no markup on ad spend. From £600 a month plus ad spend.
- [Pricing](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/pricing): every package and price in one place.

## Specialisms
- [Automotive SEO and Google Ads](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/automotive-seo): for car leasing brokers, dealers and vehicle businesses.
- [Web design Edinburgh](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/web-design-edinburgh) and [SEO Edinburgh](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/seo-edinburgh): for established businesses in Edinburgh and the Lothians.

## Proof
- [Car leasing broker case study](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/case-studies/organic-turnaround-uk-automotive): inbound leads tripled in four months and sales went from around 300 to over 1,000 a month.
- [All results](https://www.strathmarkconsulting.com/case-studies)
